transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I can’t keep my thoughts organized anymore, and it’s getting hard to make even simple decisions at work. It's started causing some real problems with my scheduling, and my supervisor actually suggested I come see someone because my mind has been so scattered.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being controlled, or that someone is inserting thoughts into your mind?
No, I've never felt like someone else was putting thoughts into my head or controlling them. My mind definitely feels scattered and sometimes goes completely blank, but it's always my own thoughts.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that others don't, especially when there's no one around?
No, I've never heard any voices or seen things that aren't actually there. Nothing like that has ever happened to me.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes, I've actually been feeling that way for about a month now. It's like this heavy, empty sadness, almost like a gray cloud sitting on my chest, and I feel completely hollow and tear up for no reason even when I'm with my family.
Do you often feel nervous, restless, or on edge, or have you had sudden episodes of intense fear or discomfort that came out of nowhere?

I don't really have those sudden episodes of intense fear or panic out of nowhere. I definitely get restless and wound up, but that's usually either when I'm in one of my high-energy phases or when I'm lying awake at night worrying about my mom, rather than feeling constantly nervous.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or felt like your thoughts were racing, even if it didn't bother you at the time?

Yes, I definitely get those phases where I feel like I'm powered by a motor, sleeping only three or four hours a night but waking up totally charged. I feel like I'm the only one who can handle everything, so I'll take on tons of extra clients and home projects, though I also get easily distracted and find myself snapping at people.
Have you had more than one episode of feeling this unusually energetic and needing less sleep, and if so, how long did those periods typically last?

Yes, I've had these wired phases happen off and on for about a couple of years now, though they've gotten much more frequent and intense over the past year with the stress over my mom. I don't really have an exact count of how many days each energetic stretch lasts before I crash back down, but it has definitely happened multiple times.

opening_question.question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of mood disturbance including distinct periods of depression and (hypo)manic symptoms, which are characteristic of bipolar II disorder. The presence of multiple hypomanic episodes with increased energy, reduced sleep, impulsivity, distractibility, and psychomotor agitation, alternating with major depressive episodes lasting at least one month, supports this diagnosis. There is no evidence of psychosis or panic attacks, and mood symptoms are not better explained by an anxiety disorder.
